hero.title: Source code stays in your data center.
hero.subtitle: ForgeHelm reads your code, maps it against 24 frameworks — ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, PCI-DSS and more — and shows you what falls short, what to fix first, and evidence your auditors can actually read. Choose hybrid or on-premises deployment and the analysis engine (Agent) runs inside your network, so your source code doesn't have to go anywhere.

coreValues.title: Built for organizations whose source code can't leave the building

v1.title: Hybrid Deployment

modules.title: Seven Modules, One Platform
modules.subtitle: From compliance reports to legacy modernization, everything happens in one place — and source code stays in your network.

m1.title: Compliance Reports
m1.description: Takes the results of mapping your code against 24 frameworks and turns them into reports an auditor can read: which controls have code-level evidence, which don't, and where to start. Exports to PDF, Excel, CSV, or Word, in six languages.
m1.detail3: Three risk assessment methods: ISO 31000, NIST RMF, ISO 27005
m1.detail4: Framework coverage matrix; every finding points to a file and line number

m2.title: SBOM
m2.description: Which packages each project uses, under what licenses, with which known vulnerabilities — all in one list. Exports in both CycloneDX and SPDX, so you can hand auditors and customers whichever format they ask for.
m2.detail4: Supply chain risk at a glance

m3.title: Governance Dashboard
m3.description: Click from the whole organization down to the one subsystem with the problem. Compliance coverage, trend charts, and risk heat maps — you won't get lost even with a hundred subsystems.
m3.detail1: Drill down: organization → main system → subsystem

m4.title: Risk Questionnaire
m4.description: A maturity survey across five areas: handover, requirements traceability, change impact, acceptance criteria, and communication cost. Shown as a radar chart with improvement recommendations, downloadable as a PDF report.
m4.detail1: Five areas (M1 handover through M5 communication cost)

m5.title: AI Assistant
m5.description: Answers questions from your own governance data: what this finding means, how much it matters, and what to fix first. Replies stream in as they're written, and it can run fully offline.
m5.detail1: Answers grounded in your governance data
m5.detail3: Fully offline with your own model
m5.detail4: Works with external models or your own local model

m6.title: Tech Stack Migration
m6.description: Automatically converts code from an older framework to a newer one (for example, .NET Framework to .NET 9), compares compliance before and after, and keeps every stage's output in the Document Center for download.
m6.detail3: Each stage's output kept in the Document Center

m7.title: Data Quality
m7.description: Finds unused database objects, duplicate tables, inconsistent naming, and whatever is slowing performance — a starting point for paying down technical debt.

about.title: About | Smart Sequence Tech
about.description: ForgeHelm is built by Smart Sequence Tech in Taiwan to make software compliance a check that runs automatically every day — with source code staying in your network.
about.heroTitle: We built ForgeHelm because compliance shouldn't cost you your source code.
about.heroSubtitle: Companies in regulated industries face more compliance requirements every year, yet they can't send source code to an outside scanner. So we put the scanning engine inside your network — and turn compliance into a check that runs every day instead of a sprint before the annual audit.
about.missionText: Make software compliance a continuous, measurable daily practice — not an annual audit sprint.
about.p1Text: Every requirement becomes a list of findings you can count and track — pointing to files and line numbers — not a checklist someone ticks by hand.
about.p2Text: Code and analysis run in an environment you trust. That line is drawn into the architecture, not left to a promise.
about.p3Text: Interface and reports in six languages; regional regulations like Taiwan's PDPA, Japan's APPI and ISMAP, and the EU's DORA are among the 24 frameworks; pricing quoted in local currency.
about.marketsNote: The product interface and compliance reports are available in Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, German, Korean, and Simplified Chinese.
about.companyName: Smart Sequence Tech (智序資訊工作室)
about.d1Title: The product runs in your environment
about.d1Text: With hybrid or on-premises deployment, the analysis engine (Agent) runs inside your network, and source code and analysis results stay on your side — we neither need nor receive your source code. On the cloud-only Core plan, analysis runs in our environment; the privacy policy spells out exactly how.
about.d2Text: Support runs over email with replies on business days. If you need guaranteed response times or dedicated staffing, we can set that out in a consulting agreement.
about.d3Title: Consulting is billed by the hour
about.d3Text: The platform fee covers deploying the Agent and getting it running. Implementation consulting — turning audit requirements into rules, writing them up, training your team — is billed by the hour, with scope and deliverables agreed before we start.
about.deliveryNote: The studio also takes on AI adoption consulting and multilingual content projects — enquiries are welcome by email.

product.title: Product | ForgeHelm — Seven Governance Modules
product.description: ForgeHelm's seven modules: compliance reports, SBOM, governance dashboard, risk questionnaire, AI assistant, tech stack migration, and data quality — with source code staying in your network.
product.heroSubtitle: From compliance checks that run automatically every day to safely modernizing legacy systems, it all happens in one place — and source code stays inside your network throughout.
product.audienceTitle: What the CISO, the CTO, and the dev team each see
product.audience1Desc: Compliance status across every project at a glance: risk heat maps, trends, and what to tackle first
product.audience2Desc: Framework coverage matrix, audit log export, supply chain inventory (SBOM)
product.audience3Desc: Hook into your scanning pipeline, automated code transformation (codemod), database health analysis
product.sec1Desc: Only file names, line numbers, and summary counts leave the Agent; code fragments and paths are masked or replaced with placeholders before they go out.
product.sec2Desc: Layered by role — view, configure, export, admin — each with its own boundary, enforcing least privilege. Sign-in is username and password with session controls; SSO/SAML is on the roadmap.
product.sec3Desc: Full logical isolation between tenants. Every customer runs the same codebase — no per-customer forks — so security patches land for everyone at once.
product.sec4Desc: Every sign-in, policy change, report generation, and data export is recorded: who, when, what, and the result. Entries are hash-chained, so any altered record is detectable, and the log is queryable via API.
product.ctaTitle: Try it in your own environment
product.fingerprintSubtitle: Eight dimensions on one radar chart — and you can see at a glance which axes are measured and which aren't.
product.fingerprintLive: One axis measured, four estimated, three from your survey
product.fingerprintDesc: Security posture is measured by the analysis engine (Agent). Documentation completeness, test coverage, dependency risk, and technical debt are currently system default estimates, marked (est.) on the chart and never counted as risk findings. Onboarding, change impact, and consensus gap come from the risk questionnaire you fill in. As analyzer coverage expands, an axis switches from estimated to measured automatically.
product.finopsSubtitle: Flat per-seat pricing, no taxi meter. Your invoice doesn't depend on how many report pages you generated or how many API calls you made.
product.finopsLeadDesc: Analyses and AI questions over a rolling 30 days
product.finopsEnterpriseDesc: Governance actions are written to the audit log, queryable via API or downloadable as CSV for finance or compliance review
product.byolTitle: Bring Your Own Model (BYOL) for the AI Assistant — Enterprise
product.byolSubtitle: The AI assistant can run on your own GPU servers, connected to Ollama, vLLM, or any model server that speaks the OpenAI API. Source code and questions both stay inside your network.

architecture.title: Architecture | ForgeHelm — Analysis Engine in Your Network, Management Platform in the Cloud
architecture.description: ForgeHelm keeps the analysis engine (Agent, installed in your network) separate from the management platform (SaaS): code stays in your network, and only masked summary counts go out.
architecture.heroTitle: An architecture designed to leave source code where it is
architecture.heroSubtitle: Analysis happens inside your network; only masked file names, line numbers, and summary counts cross the boundary. Three components, each with its own boundary, each upgraded independently.
architecture.agentDesc: Installed inside your network, with the task queue and analysis results stored in a PostgreSQL database you provide; all scanning and analysis runs locally. Triggered by GitHub webhooks, scheduled polling, or an API call from your CI. Source code is never sent out.
architecture.saasDesc: Tenant management, project settings, dashboards, report output, and collaboration workflows all live here. Use our hosted cloud, or install the whole thing in your own environment.
architecture.contractsDesc: The data formats between the Agent and the management platform are explicitly versioned, so upgrading either side doesn't break the other.
architecture.dataFlow1: The Agent receives a trigger: webhook, poll, or API call
architecture.dataFlow2: Analysis runs inside your network; source code doesn't leave
architecture.dataFlow3: Results are masked, keeping only file names, line numbers, and summary counts
architecture.dataFlow4: The masked summary is pushed to the management platform in real time
architecture.dataFlow5: The management platform renders dashboards and generates compliance reports
architecture.ai1Desc: Served by a model we host (currently the Google Gemini API) — the fastest to get started. Code snippets used for AI retrieval are sent to that provider for indexing. All three plans use the same assistant; Core is metered by quota.
architecture.ai2Title: On-Premises Retrieval, Your Choice of Model (Professional)
architecture.ai2Desc: The Agent handles data retrieval and secrets screening inside your network, then sends the question to the model endpoint you choose — public cloud or your own VPC — with no usage cap.
architecture.ai3Title: Fully Offline, Bring Your Own Model (BYOL, Enterprise)
architecture.ai3Desc: Use the AI Deployment Kit to run an open-source model on your own GPUs; questions and answers never leave your network.
architecture.aiNote: With AI turned off, the five modules — reports, SBOM, dashboards, migration, and data quality — work as usual; only the AI assistant needs a model. Before an answer is sent, the assistant screens for common password and API key patterns so they don't leak out with the reply.
architecture.deploy1Desc: Management platform and analysis both in the cloud, run by us.
architecture.deploy1When1: Policy allows code analysis in the cloud
architecture.deploy2Desc: Management platform in the cloud, Agent installed in your network. Source code doesn't leave your network.
architecture.deploy2When1: Source code has to stay in your hands
architecture.deploy2When2: You want both speed and security
architecture.deploy2When3: Regulated industries such as finance and healthcare
architecture.deploy3Desc: Every component installed in your data center or private cloud; you control all compute and storage.
architecture.deploy3When2: Company policy allows no cloud at all
architecture.deploy3When3: Government agencies and organizations that need full control of their infrastructure
architecture.deploy4Desc: Fully offline with no outbound connections. Updates arrive as signed packages on physical media.
architecture.ctaArchTitle: Want to validate this architecture in your own environment?
architecture.ctaArchDesc: Request a two-week proof of concept (PoC): you pick a representative repository, and we set up the Agent inside your network, run the scan, and deliver the report. Code stays in your environment the entire time.
architecture.byolTitle: AI Deployment Kit for Your Own Model (BYOL, Enterprise)
architecture.byolSubtitle: Bring your own GPUs and an open-source model; ForgeHelm supplies a pre-configured deployment bundle so the entire AI governance stack stays inside your network.
architecture.byolItem1: A set of deployment templates that stand up the Agent's AI service, Ollama, and the vector database in one go
architecture.byolItem2: Offline installers and model download guides for air-gapped environments
architecture.byolItem3: Container images are distributed through a license server; licenses can be verified offline with no callback to us

compliance.title: Compliance Frameworks | ForgeHelm — 24 Frameworks Mapped in One Scan
compliance.description: Every ForgeHelm scan maps your code against 24 international and regional frameworks at once: ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, Taiwan's PDPA, APPI, ISMAP, and more.
compliance.heroTitle: 24 frameworks. One scan maps them all.
compliance.heroSubtitle: No picking a framework first, no add-on modules, and it's the same on all three plans. Scan results are mapped to the controls in every framework and become a list of findings you can count.
compliance.r1: Framework coverage matrix — which controls have code-level evidence, which have some, and which have none yet
compliance.r2: Every finding points to a specific file and line number
compliance.r4: Risk assessment summary using ISO 31000, NIST RMF, or ISO 27005
compliance.r5: Export to PDF, Excel, CSV, or Word in six languages
compliance.ctaTitle: Want to see how the framework you care about maps?
compliance.frameworksNote: Every scan maps against all 24 built-in frameworks at once, on every plan.
compliance.exportLangs: Reports export in Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, German, Korean, and Simplified Chinese. Non-English reports are produced with AI-assisted translation; in air-gapped environments, non-English output requires your own model.
compliance.boundaryTitle: What ForgeHelm covers — and what it doesn't
compliance.boundaryText: Standards like ISO 27001 audit your information security management system, not your code. ForgeHelm provides code-level evidence for the technical controls — secure development, change management, vulnerabilities and dependencies, use of cryptography, access control. Policies, risk assessment, and organizational controls stay with you and your consultants. Whether you pass an audit depends on whether the findings get fixed — the auditor makes that call, not us.

pricing.title: Pricing | ForgeHelm — Per-Seat, Every Price Published
pricing.description: Three plans — Core, Professional, Enterprise — billed annually per seat in USD, TWD, JPY, EUR, and CNY, with every price published excluding tax.
pricing.heroTitle: Every price, out in the open
pricing.heroSubtitle: Three plans, five currencies, listed as annual prices excluding tax. The plans differ in deployment and usage, not features — all 24 frameworks, reports, and SBOM are the same on every plan. Professional and Enterprise put the analysis engine (Agent) inside your network and carry an annual platform fee; Core doesn't.
pricing.billedAnnually: Billed annually (monthly rate shown, excl. tax)
pricing.planCoreDesc: Cloud only. Code is uploaded to the ForgeHelm cloud for analysis — 50 analyses and 500 AI questions a month. If your source code can't leave the building, see Professional.
pricing.planProDesc: Management platform in the cloud, Agent installed in your network. Unlimited analyses and AI assistant.
pricing.planEnterpriseDesc: The whole platform in your data center, or in a fully offline, air-gapped environment. Use your own AI model.
pricing.tierBasisNote: All three plans have the same frameworks, reports, and modules; they differ in deployment, usage limits, and where the AI model runs. Email us to talk through which setup fits your environment.
pricing.platformFeeNote: An annual platform fee applies to run the Agent inside your network
pricing.faqQ1: What does the PoC process look like?
pricing.faqA1: A scoped two-week proof of concept (PoC): you pick a representative repository, and we set up the Agent inside your network, run a compliance scan, and deliver the report. Code stays in your environment the entire time. Details and fees are explained when you apply.
pricing.faqQ2: Can we pay monthly instead of annually?
pricing.faqA2: Listed prices are annual. Where monthly billing is offered, seat fees typically run about 20% higher than annual. Enterprise is usually an annual contract with custom payment terms.
pricing.faqQ3: What does the security review process involve?
pricing.faqA3: We provide architecture documentation, data flow diagrams, a penetration test summary, and the role-based access control (RBAC) specification; standard vendor security questionnaires can usually be returned within five business days. The sub-processor list is available on request by email.
pricing.faqQ4: Is the platform fee separate from seat fees?
pricing.faqA4: Yes. The platform fee covers deploying the Agent inside your network and getting it running; features don't vary by plan, and Core has no platform fee. Implementation consulting — turning audit requirements into rules and documenting them — is billed separately by the hour.
pricing.faqA5: Yes. Seats added during the contract term are prorated for the remaining period; seat reductions take effect at the next renewal.
pricing.faqA6: Support runs over email, answered on business days. If you need guaranteed response times or dedicated staffing, we can set that out in a consulting agreement.
pricing.ctaSubtitle: Book a 30-minute demo, or request a two-week proof of concept (PoC).
pricing.annualFormula: Annual fee = seat monthly rate × seats × 12 + platform annual fee
pricing.annualExample: NT$2,200 × 10 seats × 12 months + NT$192,000 annual platform fee = NT$456,000 total per year (excl. tax)

pricing.compVantaAdv: Complementary: Vanta manages policies, people, and processes; ForgeHelm supplies code-level compliance evidence that can be exported to a GRC platform
pricing.compCheckmarxAdv: Different category: Checkmarx is a vulnerability scanner; ForgeHelm Enterprise with private AI has a total cost of ownership of about $31K–$39K (10 seats)
pricing.tcoForgeHelmGpu: GPU depreciation (only if you opt for a private AI model): $2,000–$10,000/year
pricing.tcoForgeHelmTotal: Total: about $31,280–$39,280/year (roughly NT$1.0M–1.26M), before tax and consulting hours
pricing.tcoCheckmarx: Checkmarx (vulnerability scanner — different category, shown for budget scale)

pricing.faqA7: Yes. Pay for a trial, then upgrade to an annual Core or Professional subscription within 30 days and the full trial fee is credited toward your first year. Enterprise is excluded.

payment.title: Payment & e-Invoice | Smart Sequence Tech
payment.description: ForgeHelm subscription checkout: confirm your order, choose a payment method, and specify a mobile barcode carrier or an invoice donation code.
payment.heroSubtitle: Review your order, choose a payment method, and tell us how to issue your invoice. Cloud e-invoices are issued under Taiwan Ministry of Finance rules.
payment.invoiceDesc: Choose an invoice type. "Individual" lets you enter a mobile barcode carrier; "Donation" requires the recipient's love code; "Company / Agency" requires a unified business number and invoice title.
payment.carrierHint: The Ministry of Finance common carrier: starts with "/" and is 8 characters in total, using uppercase letters, digits, and . - +. If left blank, the invoice is issued as an e-invoice and sent to the invoice notification email you entered.
payment.donateHint: The love code of the receiving organisation: 3 to 7 digits, searchable on the Ministry of Finance e-invoice platform. Donated invoices are not issued as a printed certificate.
payment.taxIdHint: Eight digits; required for a triplicate e-invoice.
payment.notice1: Cloud e-invoices are issued under Ministry of Finance rules; no paper invoice is mailed.
payment.notice2: If you donate the invoice, the recipient cannot be changed afterwards and no printed invoice certificate will be issued.
payment.notice3: If you provide a mobile barcode carrier, the invoice is filed to that carrier and prize notifications come from the Ministry of Finance platform.
payment.notice4: If a refund is issued under the Terms of Service or a written contract, the invoice will be adjusted by allowance or voided under the Regulations Governing the Use of Uniform Invoices.
payment.securityNote: Amounts on this page are in New Taiwan dollars and include tax. The invoice is issued as specified above once payment completes.
payment.taxIncludedNote: All prices are in New Taiwan dollars, tax included.
payment.payNoteAtm: After you place the order we issue a virtual account number and a payment deadline for that order. Transfer to it from online banking or an ATM before the deadline — the number is generated by our payment provider, so you do not need to supply one.
payment.payNoteTransfer: After you place the order we email you our bank details and a reference code. Include the code with your transfer so we can match the payment.

services.title: Consulting & Delivery | Smart Sequence Tech
services.description: ForgeHelm implementation, AI architecture review and workflow build-out, multilingual content governance. Delivered as documents; problem first, technology second.
services.heroSubtitle: We turn quality into checks that run every day, instead of problems you discover the week before delivery. That is how we build our own product, and how we work on yours.
services.s1Text: We install ForgeHelm in your environment and turn your audit obligations into checks that run every day: which requirement maps to which check, what should be blocked, how exceptions get approved — all configured and documented for your team. Next audit, the report is already there.
services.s2Text: Most AI projects stall not because the model isn't smart enough, but because nobody defined the problem first. We start by agreeing on what needs solving and how success will be measured, then lay out the workable options side by side — cost, risk, and what we'd advise against — rather than handing you a deck that leaves you no closer to a decision. Once the direction is set, a working prototype proves the route holds up before we move into the full build. We can take it all the way, or hand off to your team at whatever point makes sense.
services.s3Text: Multilingual delivery for high-stakes material: consistent terminology, machine transcription corrected sentence by sentence, natural line breaks, and a record you can trace. See the case above for how it works.
services.h1Title: Progress that doesn't take up your meeting time
services.h1Text: Send requirements by form or email; proposals and progress come back as documents and screen recordings that you and your team review when it suits you, with every decision in writing.
services.h2Title: Define the problem before the technology
services.h2Text: We write down the problem and what success looks like before anything is built. If we conclude that you do not need AI here, or that the timing is wrong, we will say so plainly.
services.h3Text: Scripts, comparison tables and documentation live in your own environment. When the engagement ends they are still yours, and nothing stops working because a subscription lapsed.
services.billingText: Billed by the hour or by project. Scope, hours, and deliverables are agreed before we start and billed separately from ForgeHelm license fees; see the pricing page for the deployment and onboarding help the license fee already includes.
services.caseTitle: Subtitles for a 30-hour course at an education organisation
services.caseIntro: Seven sessions, 22 video segments. Machine transcription arrives full of misheard terms, wrong punctuation and verbal filler. We built a re-runnable AI pipeline for this project that corrects the text sentence by sentence against the vocabulary of the field and the speaker’s own way of talking, then breaks long stretches of speech into lines that read naturally — turning a recording into text people can actually read and subtitles that run correctly and smoothly.
services.step1Text: Speech is turned into raw text. This is only a half-product: mishearings and stumbles are recorded as-is.
services.step2Text: Wrong words, punctuation and verbal filler are fixed against the vocabulary of the field and the speaker’s own way of talking.
services.step3Text: One line per frame, length kept in check, with terms and citations never split across two frames.
services.step4Text: Consistent wording, file encoding, script purity and line length are all enforced by software.
services.step5Text: Lines are aligned to the video timeline. Where the audio genuinely is not clear we do not guess: those spots go on a list with timestamps, for whoever knows the material best to decide.
services.caseNote: The pipeline stayed with the client: every revision of the script saves another full proofread. The same approach works for manuals, courses and product documentation in several languages.
services.servicesTitle: What you can commission us for
services.byolIntro: Put a large language model inside your own server room or cloud account, so neither your data nor your prompts leave your boundary. It suits teams under strict compliance rules, or teams that cannot send source code and customer data to an outside service. We handle the work from boundary mapping to handover, and you can maintain it afterwards.
services.byolStep1Text: We establish what may leave your network and what may not, alongside compliance obligations and the hardware and network you already have.
services.byolStep2Text: Open models and hardware options are compared for your workload and traffic, with cost, risk and what we would advise against.
services.byolStep3Text: The service runs on your own GPU hosts or internal network, behind an industry-standard interface, so swapping models later does not mean rewriting applications.
services.byolStep4Text: Who used what, how much it cost, and which sources an answer drew on — all recorded in a form you can hand to an auditor.
services.byolStep5Text: Deployment scripts and configuration stay in your repository. Changing models, adding machines or rebuilding the environment is another run, not another project.
services.byolNote: What matters on this track is not how new the model is, but settling boundaries, cost and auditability up front — those three decide whether the system survives inside your company.
services.caseBridge: We can also build an AI workflow made for you. The project below is a subtitle-processing pipeline we planned and built for a client running online courses.
